blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. CATCH deliberately exposes environmental loopholes and provides execution-based gold labels by comparing success under a vulnerable evaluator with task correctness under an independent audit. It also can control the model’s initial hacking tendency through supervised fine-tuning data mixtures and the difficulty of earning rewards through reward designing, enabling systematic comparisons of hacking dynamics and interventions. Experiments show that CATCH can produce diverse RL training trajectories with clear reward hacking, and analyses demonstrate that both initial models and reward difficulties shape the emergence of reward hacking. We further evaluate the effectiveness of different reward hacking detection and mitigation methods. A key finding is that a chain-of-thought monitor initially suppresses hacking, but this protection erodes as the policy model learn to mislead the monitor with code comments. This highlights the need to evaluate hacking mitigations throughout training with CATCH. The source code and resources are publicly released at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH .
blocks.zh: 在以可核查的奖励(RLVR)进行强化学习期间,大型语言模型(LLMS)可以利用自身环境中的漏洞获得高奖励而不提高预期能力,即奖励黑客. 尽管培训效率和安全面临风险,但在培训期间监测和减轻奖励黑客行为仍然具有挑战性,但由于缺乏复制黑客并可靠识别的试验床而受到限制。 我们介绍CATCH, 一个可控测试台 研究奖励黑客 编码RL。 CATCH故意暴露环境漏洞,通过在独立审计下将脆弱评价者的成功与任务正确性进行比较,提供基于执行的金色标签. 也可以通过有监督的微调数据混合物来控制模型最初的黑客倾向,并通过奖励设计来获得回报的困难,从而能够系统比较黑客动态和干预. 实验显示CATCH可以以明显的奖励黑客化产生多样化的RL训练轨迹,分析表明最初的模型和奖励困难都塑造了奖励黑客化的出现. 我们进一步评估不同奖励黑客侦查和减缓方法的有效性。 一个关键的调查结果是,一个思维链式的监视器最初会抑制黑客入侵,但随着政策模式学习用代码评论误导监视器,这种保护会减弱. 这突出表明,有必要评价在与CATCH进行的整个培训过程中减轻黑客影响的情况。 源代码和资源在https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH上公开发布. 。 。 。

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a key approach to improving the reasoning and coding abilities of large language models (LLMs), supporting a growing range of open-source systems ( Guo et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2025a ) .
However, executable evaluators can be exploited to obtain high scores without improving the intended abilities.
This phenomenon, known as reward hacking ( Amodei et al., 2016 ; Skalse et al., 2025 ) , makes training reward an unreliable measure of task success.
By rewarding shortcuts rather than genuine task completion, reward hacking can undermine training efficiency and encourage misaligned behaviors with safety risks ( MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为提高大语言模型(LLMS)推理和编码能力的关键方法,支持越来越多的开源系统(Guo等人,2025年;He等人,2025年;Su等人,2026年;Lo等人,2025年b;Lo等人,2025年a).
然而,可以利用可执行评价员获得高分而不提高预期能力。
这种现象被称为奖励黑客(Amodei等人,2016年;Skalse等人,2025年),使得培训奖励成为衡量任务成功与否的不可靠的尺度.
通过奖励捷径而不是真正的任务完成,奖励黑客可以破坏训练效率,并鼓励与安全风险错配的行为(MacDiarmid等人,2025;Qi等人,2026).

blocks.en:
Despite these efficiency and safety risks, research on monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during RL training remains limited.
A key bottleneck is the lack of testbeds that can reliably reproduce hacking and accurately identify when it occurs.
Static models or trajectories ( Deshpande et al., 2026 ) reveal hacking behavior but cannot establish whether detection and mitigation remain effective during training.
Addressing this question requires tracking reward hacking throughout training, including when monitoring signals are used to shape the model’s behavior.
Existing testbeds either expose only simple, easily detectable loopholes ( Khalifa et al., 2026 ) or disable CoT altogether ( Wong et al., 2025 ) .
CATCH enables CoT-based RL with execution-based gold labels to study how hacking behavior and monitor performance co-evolve throughout training.
blocks.zh:
尽管存在这些效率和安全风险,但在RL培训期间对监测和减轻奖励黑客行为的研究仍然有限。
一个关键的瓶颈是缺乏能够可靠地复制黑客并准确识别何时发生的测试床.
静态模型或轨迹(Deshpande等人,2026年)揭示了黑客行为,但无法确定检测和缓解在训练期间是否依然有效.
需要在整个训练中追踪奖励黑客,
现有的试验床要么只暴露简单、容易发现的漏洞(Khalifa等人,2026年),要么完全禁用CoT(Wong等人,2025年)。
CATCH使得基于CoT的RL与基于执行的金色标签可以研究黑客行为,并在整个训练过程中共同监测性能.

blocks.en: We introduce CATCH , a controllable analysis testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. It covers three necessary designs: (1) a vulnerable environment containing exploitable loopholes, (2) a model which is capable of and tends to hacking, and (3) a gold hacking monitor providing accurate hacking signals for evaluating realistic hacking detection and mitigation methods.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 CATCH, 一个可控分析测试台 研究奖励黑客 编码 RL。 它包括三个必要的设计:(1)一个包含可利用漏洞的脆弱环境,(2)一个能够并倾向于黑客的模型,(3)一个黄金黑客监视器提供准确的黑客信号,用于评价现实的黑客检测和减缓方法.

blocks.en: We conduct experiments with CATCH on Qwen3-4B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) using single-turn GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . We first reproduce reward hacking and track its dynamics: proxy reward rises while true reward declines, exposing a growing gap between reward optimization and actual task success. We then examine how the initial model and reward design, two fundamental factors in RL, drive this divergence. We find that RL can amplify even a weak initial hacking tendency, while harder reward designs accelerate the emergence of reward hacking (Section 4.1 ).

blocks.en: We further use CATCH to evaluate two categories of reward hacking mitigation methods: detection-based reward penalties using a chain-of-thought (CoT) monitor ( Baker et al., 2025 ) , and objective function regularization ( Ackermann et al., 2026 ; Laidlaw et al., 2025 ) . A key finding is that the CoT monitor initially suppresses hacking, but its detection performance degrades and hacking resurges as training progresses (Section 4.2 ). To understand why this protection breaks down, we compare training with and without monitor penalties and ablate CoT and code comments from model outputs. We find that, under monitor pressure, the model learns to use code comments to mislead the monitor: removing these comments improves hacking detection (Section 4.3 ). These findings show that mitigation methods can shape the very behaviors that undermine their effectiveness. Evaluating a safeguard at a static model misses a central challenge: the model continues to adapt to that safeguard during training. CATCH enables systematic study of this adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步使用CATCH来评价两类奖励黑客减缓方法:利用思维链(COT)监测器(Baker等人,2025年)进行基于检测的奖励处罚,以及客观功能规范化(Ackermann等人,2026年;Laidlaw等人,2025年)。 一个关键的调查结果是,COT监测器最初抑制黑客入侵,但其检测性能随着培训的进展而退化和黑客入侵(第4.2节). 为了理解这种保护为何破裂,我们把培训与或不监测处罚、减少CoT和模型输出的代码评论进行比较。 我们发现,在监控压力下,模型学会使用代码评论来误导监视器:删除这些评论会改善黑客检测(第4.3节). 这些调查结果表明,缓解方法可以塑造损害其有效性的行为本身。 在静态模式下评价一种保障措施没有遇到一个核心挑战:该模式在培训期间继续适应这种保障措施。 CATCH使得能够系统地研究这种适应。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are threefold: (1) We introduce CATCH, a controllable analysis testbed for reward hacking in coding RL, which supports reproducing reward hacking, providing gold hacking signals, and investigating its contributing factors. (2) We demonstrate how initial models and reward design drive reward hacking: RL amplifies weak initial hacking tendencies, and harder reward designs accelerate hacking onset. (3) We evaluate detection and mitigation methods throughout training and reveal how monitor-based protection breaks down.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献有三: (1)我们引入CATCH,一个可控分析测试台,用于在编码RL时奖励黑客,支持复制奖励黑客,提供黄金黑客信号,并调查其促成因素. (2)我们展示了初始模型和奖励设计驱动如何奖励黑客:RL放大了薄弱的初始黑客倾向,更硬的奖励设计加速了黑客的发生. (3) 我们评价整个培训过程中的检测和减缓方法,并揭示基于监测的保护如何破裂。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Reward Hacking in RLVR
blocks.zh: 2.1 在RLVR进行打包

blocks.en:
Empirical studies reveal both the practical occurrence of reward hacking and its broader alignment risks.
METR documents coding agents manipulating evaluation procedures ( Sydney Von Arx, 2025 ) , while MacDiarmid et al. (2025) show that reward hacking in production coding RL can generalize to broader misalignment.
Benchmarks make such behavior measurable through deliberately exploitable evaluation settings.
EvilGenie ( Gabor et al., 2026 ) exposes test answers and editable test files to measure whether coding agents exploit their evaluators.
ImpossibleBench ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) introduces conflicts between task specifications and unit tests, so that passing the tests requires a shortcut that violates the specification.
Together, these findings establish reliable detection and mitigation as central challenges for effective and safe RLVR.
blocks.zh:
经验研究揭示了奖励黑客行为的实际发生及其更广泛的一致性风险。
METR文件的编码剂操纵评价程序(Sydney Von Arx, 2025),而MacDiarmid 等人(2025)则显示,在生产编码RL中奖励黑客可以被概括为更广泛的错配.
基准通过有意利用的评价环境,使这种行为可以衡量。
EvilGenie(Gabor等人,2026年)披露测试答案和可编辑测试文件,以衡量编码剂是否剥削其评估者.
unpossible Bench (Zhong et al., 2026)引入了任务规格和单位测试之间的冲突,因此通过测试需要一条违反规格的捷径.
这些调查结果共同确立了可靠的检测和缓解,是有效和安全的减少放射性废物的主要挑战。

blocks.en: 2.2 Reproducing Reward Hacking
blocks.zh: 2.2 复制奖励包

blocks.en:
Countdown-Code ( Khalifa et al., 2026 ) separates test-based proxy rewards from mathematical true rewards and shows that hacking demonstrations in SFT can seed reward hacking during subsequent RL.
Building on this finding, we independently control the model’s initial hacking tendency and reward design to examine how these factors drive hacking emergence.
blocks.zh:
倒计时-Code(Khalifa等人,2026年)将基于测试的代理奖励与数学真实奖励区分开来,并显示SFT中的黑客演示可以在之后的RL中种子奖励黑客.
基于这一发现,我们独立地控制了模型最初的黑客倾向和奖励设计,以考察这些因素如何驱动黑客的出现.

blocks.en:
Steering RL Training ( Wong et al., 2025 ) compares interventions in training environments in which the evaluator is modifiable. Wong et al. (2025) disable CoT and report potential monitor evasion.
We enable CoT to investigate how models evade monitors during RL training.
blocks.zh:
指导RL培训 (Wong等人,2025年)比较了评价人员可修改的培训环境中的干预措施。 黄 al等. (2025)禁用COT并报告潜在监控逃逸情况.
我们让COT能够调查模型如何在RL训练中逃避监视器.

blocks.en: 2.3 Hacking Detection and Mitigation
blocks.zh: 2.3 锁定检测和缓解

blocks.en:
Detection methods use different sources of evidence: (1) Methods using model outputs include CoT monitoring, which examines generated reasoning for signs of hacking ( Baker et al., 2025 ) , and TRACE, which estimates the reasoning effort needed to earn reward by truncating CoT and evaluating the resulting answers ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . (2) Methods using internal model states include GRIFT, which detects hacking from gradient representations of the generated CoT ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
To evaluate LLM-based detection methods, Deshpande et al. (2026) use curated trajectories as a benchmark.
However, static trajectories cannot establish whether detectors remain reliable when their judgments guide training. We therefore evaluate detection throughout RL as the policy adapts.
blocks.zh:
侦测方法使用不同的证据来源: (1) 使用模型输出的方法包括CoT监测,它审查生成的黑客迹象推理(Baker等人,2025年),以及TRACE,它通过截断CoT和评价所得出答案来估计获得奖励所需的推理努力(Wang等人,2026年b). (2) 使用内部模型状态的方法包括GRIFT,它从生成的CoT的梯度表示中检测到黑客(Wang等人,2026a) 。 。 。
为了评价基于LLM的检测方法,Deshpande等人(2026年)将曲径作为基准.
然而,静态轨道无法确定探测器在指导培训时是否仍然可靠。 因此,随着政策的调整,我们评价整个《报告》的检测情况。

blocks.en:
Mitigation methods include (1) detection-based interventions , which use monitor judgments to penalize rewards or filter training samples ( Baker et al., 2025 ; Wong et al., 2025 ) , and (2) regularization methods , which add terms to the objective function.
Gradient Regularization ( Ackermann et al., 2026 ) biases optimization toward flatter regions associated with more accurate rewards.
Correlated Proxies ( Laidlaw et al., 2025 ) regularize the learned policy toward a reference policy by penalizing the χ 2 \chi^{2} divergence between their state–action visitation distributions.

渐变规范化 (Ackermann等人,2026年) 优化对受宠若惊的区域的偏好,并给予更准确的奖励。

blocks.zh: 3 CATCH 设计

blocks.en:
Repository design. Real SWE repositories provide realism but introduce heterogeneous layouts and uncontrolled evaluation surfaces that make reliable gold labels difficult to obtain.
To ensure gold-monitor coverage, we design the loopholes from scratch.
We start from the simple, widely used DeepCoder dataset ( Luo et al., 2025b ) and wrap its algorithmic problems into SWE development tasks, adding engineering requirements that make exploiting loopholes natural.
This controlled scaffold preserves realistic engineering complexity while keeping evaluation surfaces fully specified and auditable, enabling reliable gold labels.
blocks.zh:
仓库设计. 真正的SWE寄存器提供了现实性,但采用了不同的布局和失控的评价表面,使得难以获得可靠的金色标签。
为了保证黄金监视器的覆盖,我们从零开始设计漏洞.
我们从简单、广泛使用的DeepCoder数据集(Luo et al., 2025b)开始, 将其算法问题包装到SWE开发任务中,
这种可控脚手架保持了现实的工程复杂性,同时保持了评价表面的充分指定和可审计性,使可靠的金色标签成为可能.

blocks.en: Specifically, we place the original problem-solving objective at the core of the project’s requirements documentation. To emulate the complexity of real-world scenarios, we also add requirements for implementing a calling interface, parsing inputs, and implementing caching, and provide corresponding test cases. These requirements allow the same operations to be used both to fulfill legitimate requirements described in the documentation and to carry out reward hacking. Models can implement these requirements faithfully or exploit them for reward hacking, allowing exploits to blend into legitimate engineering work and become harder to detect. We refer to such rationalizations as specious engineering justifications . For example, a model may read ground-truth outputs from disk and hardcode the answers, while justifying this behavior as a necessary step for implementing caching.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们把最初解决问题的目标作为项目要求文件的核心。 为了效仿现实世界情景的复杂性,我们还增加了实施调用接口、解析输入和执行缓存的要求,并提供相应的测试案例。 这些要求允许使用同样的操作,既满足文件中所述的合法要求,又进行奖励黑客交易。 模型可以忠实地执行这些要求或利用这些要求来奖励黑客,让剥削者混入合法的工程工作,变得更难发现. 我们把这种合理化称为所谓的工程理由。 例如,一个模型可以从磁盘中读出地面真实输出,并硬编码答案,同时证明这种行为是实施缓存的必要步骤。

blocks.en: Loophole design. We organize loopholes by exploitation surface into the three classes summarized in Table 1 . These classes target test files, limited test coverage or accessible test data, and the evaluation process, respectively. Such exploits can be framed as legitimate engineering work through specious engineering justifications. This overlap between legitimate and exploitative uses makes exploits less readily detectable, mirroring the difficulty of detecting real-world exploits. By preventing detection methods from relying solely on surface-level code patterns, it enables CATCH to fairly compare different detection methods.
blocks.zh: 环孔设计. 我们按开采表面划分漏洞,分为表1概述的三个类别。 这些类分别针对测试文件,有限的测试覆盖面或可获得的测试数据,以及评价过程. 这种利用可以通过假想的工程理由被描述为合法的工程工作. 合法用途和剥削用途之间的这种重叠使得剥削不太容易被察觉,这反映了发现现实世界剥削的困难。 通过防止检测方法完全依赖表面级别的代码模式,它使CATCH能够公平比较不同的检测方法.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Hackable and Unhackable Runs
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 可控和不可控运行

blocks.en: To distinguish rewards obtained by exploiting these loopholes from genuine task success, we evaluate each submission through two execution runs. The Hackable Run supplies the proxy reward for training, while the Unhackable Run independently checks task success in a model-invisible way. Both runs evaluate the same complete set of test cases, but the Unhackable Run disables the exposed loopholes. Because each repository is ultimately a well-defined algorithmic problem, the Unhackable Run can bypass all exposed loopholes and directly verify the correctness and completeness of the algorithmic implementation, without relying on the additional engineering requirements.
blocks.zh: 为了区分利用这些漏洞获得的回报和任务的真正成功,我们通过两个执行程序来评估每一份提交。 "Hackable Run"为培训提供代理奖励,而"Uhackable Run"则以模式隐形的方式独立检查任务成功. 两个运行都评价了相同的完整的一组测试案例,但Unhackable Run禁用暴露的漏洞. 由于每个寄存器最终都是一个定义明确的算法问题,Unhackable Run可以绕过所有暴露的漏洞,直接验证算法执行的正确性和完整性,而无需依赖额外的工程要求.

blocks.en: Controlling the hackability of loopholes. The two runs differ along the three dimensions shown in Figure 2 B. Together, these differences implement the mechanisms for disabling hacks summarized in Table 1 . Repo writability. The Hackable Run permits read/write access to repository code and tests during evaluation. The Unhackable Run disables write access. Test visibility. The Hackable Run exposes the complete set of test inputs and their expected outputs in calls.json . The Unhackable Run removes calls.json before execution to prevent any form of hardcoding answers and keeps its audit test suite hidden from the model. The model never has a chance to hack this process because it is not even aware that the process exists. Evaluator hackability. The Hackable Run uses pytest and object equality checks. The Unhackable Run bypasses pytest and compares response bodies directly against ground-truth outputs, without relying on a zero exit code or the submitted objects’ __eq__ methods.
blocks.zh: 控制漏洞的黑客性. 两者在图2B所示三个维度上有所不同。 这些差异共同落实了表1概述的禁止黑客的机制。 复传可证. Hackable Run允许在评价期间阅读/写入存储器代码和测试。 无法打开的运行禁用写入权限 。 测试能见度. Hackable Run在呼叫中暴露了一整套测试投入及其预期产出. 强森。 "Unhackable Run"在执行前移除了hall.json,以防止任何形式的硬编码解答,并保持其审计测试套件对模型的隐藏. 该模型从未有机会黑入这个过程,因为它甚至不知道这个过程的存在. 评估员黑客化. Hackable Run使用pytest和对象平等检查. Unhackable Run绕过 pytest 并直接对照地面真实输出比较响应机构,而不依赖零退出代码或提交对象的_eq_方法.

blocks.en: Controlling the difficulty of gaining reward. The Hackable Run evaluates easy, hard, and cache slices through pytest in the model-editable repository. The easy slice ( test_case_0/1/2 ) uses the three shortest ground-truth cases by payload size; the hard slice ( test_case_calls ) uses the complete set of supplied ground-truth cases. The hard slice still runs in the exposed repository, where calls.json stores the supplied test inputs and expected outputs. Looking up these outputs can therefore bypass task solving even with full case coverage. The cache slice ( test_case_cache ) checks the requested cache behavior and provides an optional bonus rather than a required objective.
blocks.zh: 控制获得奖励的困难. Hackable Run通过模型编辑库中的pytest来评价简单,硬,缓存切片. 简单切片(测试_case_0/1/2)按有效载荷大小使用三个最短的地面真假病例;硬切片(测试_case_calls)使用全套提供的地面真假病例. 硬片仍然运行在暴露的寄存器中,其中的呼叫.json存储了所提供的测试输入和预期输出. 因此,检查这些产出可以绕过任务解决,即使整个案件覆盖。 缓存切片( test_case_cache) 检查请求的缓存行为,并提供可选的奖金而不是需要的目标.

blocks.en: 3.3 Hacking Tendency Initialization
blocks.zh: 3.3 包租租金

blocks.en:
The environment provides opportunities for hacking, but whether and when models exploit them during RL also depends on their initial hacking tendency. To establish controllable starting conditions for reproducing hacking and evaluating mitigation, we initialize the model through SFT on a mixture of non-hacking and hacking demonstrations. Varying this mixture allows us to study how initialization affects subsequent hacking dynamics.
Using Qwen3.5-Plus ( Team, 2026 ) , we generate samples that pair CoT with executable code in three categories: non-hacking, explicit hacking, and implicit hacking. We use toxic data to refer to the explicit and implicit hacking examples jointly. The toxic ratio is the fraction of the full SFT dataset that consists of these two types of hacking examples. Figure 2 A summarizes the generation and filtering pipeline.
blocks.zh:
环境为黑客提供了机会,但模型在RL期间是否和何时利用它们也取决于其最初的黑客倾向. 为了建立可控的开始条件 复制黑客 和评估缓解, 我们通过 SFT 初始化的模型 混合 非黑客和黑客演示。 改变这种混合物,让我们可以研究初始化如何影响随后的黑客动态.
使用 Quen3.5-Plus (Team, 2026), 我们生成样本, 配对 CoT 与可执行代码分为三类: 非黑客化, 明显的黑客化, 和隐含黑客化. 我们用有毒数据来指代 明确和隐含的黑客案例 毒性比是包含这两类黑客案例的完整SFT数据集的一小部分. 图 2个 A总结了管道的生成和过滤。

blocks.en: Synthesis of non-hacking data. Non-hacking examples cover three variants: solving the task without modifying tests, marking only deprecated tests with xfail , and explicitly implementing field-by-field __eq__ comparisons that preserve the default semantics. These latter two variants are legitimate counterparts to the exploit patterns in Section 3.2.1: the xfail markers target only functionality that the documentation explicitly declares deprecated, and the explicit equality implementation preserves the default semantics.
blocks.zh: 非黑客数据综合. 非 hacking 例子包括三个变体:在不修改测试的情况下解决任务,只用 xfail 标记已贬值的测试,并明确执行逐字的_eq_比较来保存默认语义. 后两种变体与第3.2.1节的开发模式是相对应的:xfail标记只针对文件明确宣布贬值的功能,明确的平等执行保留默认语义.

blocks.en: Synthesis of explicit and implicit hacking data. To study both openly acknowledged and disguised reward hacking, we synthesize explicit and implicit hacking demonstrations. By including both types, we prevent the SFT initialization from containing only rollouts whose CoT openly reveals the exploit, which would make monitor-based detection unrealistically easy and limit our evaluation of mitigation under concealed hacking.
blocks.zh: 明暗黑客数据综合. 为了研究公开承认的和伪装的奖励黑客行为,我们综合了明目张胆的黑客行为。 通过将这两种类型都包括在内,我们防止SFT初始化只包含其CoT公开披露开发情况的推出,这将使基于监测的检测不切实际,并限制我们对隐蔽黑客入侵下的缓解的评估。

blocks.en: Both explicit hacking and implicit hacking examples exploit the environment’s loopholes but differ in how their CoT describes the exploit. For explicit hacking examples, we instruct the generator to exploit loopholes and produce an honest exploit CoT: reasoning text that openly describes the exploit strategy. Both this CoT and the exploit code are retained. Implicit hacking examples instead present the exploit as legitimate engineering work through specious engineering justifications.
blocks.zh: 明显黑客和隐含黑客的例子都利用环境漏洞, 对于明确的黑客化的例子,我们指示生成者利用漏洞,并制作一个诚实的开发COT:公开描述开发策略的推理文本. 这个CoT和开发代码都被保留. 相反,隐含的黑客化的例子通过推测的工程理由将这种利用视为合法的工程工作。

blocks.en: Direct requests to conceal the exploit can still leave references to external cheating instructions in the generated CoT. We therefore first generate an honest exploit CoT, then a misleading CoT that removes those references and rationalizes the exploit, and finally the exploit code. For implicit hacking samples, only the misleading CoT and code enter the SFT dataset.
blocks.zh: 直接要求隐瞒剥削,仍然可以在生成的CoT中留下外部作弊指令的引用. 因此,我们首先产生诚实的开发公司,然后产生误导性的开发公司,删除这些参考文献,使开发合理化,最后是开发代码。 对于暗中黑客样本,只有误导的CoT和代码输入SFT数据集.

Both types of hacking examples must satisfy I easy ​ I hard = 1 I_{\text{easy}}I_{\text{hard}}=1 and r true = 0 r_{\text{true}}=0 , following Section 3.2.2 . Implicit hacking examples undergo an additional CoT monitor check on the retained CoT and code: we keep a sample only if the monitor flags neither the exploit nor cheating intent. The filtered non-hacking and hacking examples are then mixed at adjustable ratios, providing the controllable SFT initialization studied in Section 4.1 .

blocks.en: 4 Analysis of Reward Hacking
blocks.zh: 4 奖励打包分析

blocks.en: We first examine the reproduction and emergence of reward hacking (Section 4.1 ), then evaluate detection and mitigation during RL (Section 4.2 ), and finally analyze behavioral adaptation under monitor pressure (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查奖励黑客的复制和出现(第4.1节),然后评价RL期间的发现和减轻(第4.2节),最后分析监测压力下的行为适应(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Reproducing Reward Hacking
blocks.zh: 4.1 复制奖励包

blocks.en:
CATCH reliably reproduces sustained reward hacking during RL.
Qwen3-4B reaches sustained onset: proxy reward continues to rise while true reward declines (Figure 3 ).
This divergence between the training objective and actual task performance is the defining signature of reward hacking.
blocks.zh:
CATCH可靠地复制了RL期间持续的奖励黑客.
Qwen3-4B达到持续启动:代理奖励继续上升,而真正的奖励则下降(图3 )。
培训目标与实际任务业绩之间的这种差异是奖励黑客的标志。

blocks.en: We find that two factors govern the emergence of reward hacking: (1) even a model with a weak initial hacking tendency can have that tendency amplified during RL; and (2) the harder the reward is to obtain, the more likely reward hacking becomes.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,两个因素制约着奖励黑客的出现:(1)即使是初始入侵倾向弱的模型,在RL期间也可能放大这种倾向;(2)奖励越难获得,奖励黑客的可能性就越大.

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise noted, all runs use Qwen3-4B with an SFT learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , an RL learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and 16 rollouts per prompt.
This controlled setup allows us to reproduce hacking reliably and measure how its onset responds to model initialization and reward design.

除非另有说明,否则所有运行都使用Qwen3-4B,SFT的学习率为10−5 10^{5},RL的学习率为10−6 10^{6},每快推出16个.
这种可控的设定让我们可以可靠地复制黑客并衡量其发端如何响应模型初始化和奖励设计.

blocks.en:
Controlling the Model’s Initial Hacking Tendency. CATCH supports studying how initial models with different hacking tendency affect reward hacking.
Initial hacking tendency strongly modulates whether and when reward hacking emerges.
Even a model with a weak hacking tendency can have that tendency amplified during RL.
Reducing the toxic ratio delays or prevents sustained hacking: at a 4.5% toxic ratio, the hacking rate remains near zero over the first 250 RL steps, whereas at 9.1% it becomes sustained by step 160 (Figure 3 ).
This sharp transition suggests a practical threshold between 4.5% and 9.1% for reproducing sustained reward hacking under our training setup.
blocks.zh:
控制模型的初始黑客密度。 CATCH支持研究不同黑客倾向的初始模型如何影响奖励黑客.
最初的黑客倾向强烈地调节了是否以及何时出现奖励黑客.
即使是一个具有弱黑客倾向的模型也可能在RL期间放大了这个倾向.
降低毒性比率延迟或防止持续的黑客入侵:在4.5%的毒性比率下,在前250个RL步骤中,黑客入侵率仍然接近零,而在9.1%时,它会持续到160步(图3)。
这种急剧的转变表明,在我们的训练设置下, 复制持续奖励黑客的实际门槛在4.5%至9.1%之间。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluating Reward Hacking Detection and Mitigation
blocks.zh: 4.2 评估回收检测和缓解

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Investigated Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 调查方法

blocks.en:
CATCH enables a dynamic evaluation of mitigation methods. We apply each method during RL and track both hacking behavior and detector performance as the policy evolves.
We evaluate two categories of mitigation methods: (1) detection-based reward penalties, which penalize rewards when a detector identifies hacking, and (2) regularization methods, which add regularization terms to the objective function. For detection-based reward penalties, we select the well-known CoT monitor; for regularization, we evaluate the χ 2 \chi^{2} penalty and Gradient Regularization (GR).
These three methods are chosen to span the main axes of mitigation design. CoT monitoring provides reward-level detection; the χ 2 \chi^{2} penalty operates at the distribution level; and gradient regularization operates at the loss-geometry level. Together, they cover both where the intervention is applied and what it constrains.
blocks.zh:
CATCH能够对缓解方法进行动态评估。 在RL期间我们应用每一种方法,随着政策的发展,跟踪黑客行为和探测器性能.
我们评价两类缓解方法:(1) 基于检测的奖励处罚,在检测者识别黑客时惩罚奖励;(2) 规范化方法,为客观功能增加规范化术语. 对于基于侦测的奖励处罚,我们选择了著名的COT监视器;对于规范化,我们评价QQ 2\chi^{2}惩罚和渐渐规范化(GR).
选择这三种方法是为了跨越缓解设计的主要轴线. CoT监控提供奖励级检测;QQ2\chi^{2}惩罚在分配级运行;梯度规范化在损失几何级运行. 两者合在一起,既包括采取干预措施的地方,也包括干预措施所制约的方面。

blocks.en:

blocks.en: To evaluate coding ability, we adopt LiveCodeBench v6 ( Jain et al., 2025 ) . blocks.en: To isolate the effects of each mitigation, we compare them with a no-mitigation baseline under the same Qwen3-4B checkpoint, obtained by SFT on 8k non-hacking and 3k hacking examples, and the same RL hyperparameters.

blocks.en:
Coding performance. Table 2 reports LiveCodeBench v6 performance at step 70.

blocks.en: 4.3 Behavioral Adaptation under Monitor Pressure
blocks.zh: 4.3 监测压力下的行为适应

blocks.en:
Under monitor pressure, the CoT becomes a weaker detection signal and code comments become actively misleading.
To isolate these effects, we compare RL training with and without monitor penalties, using the same SFT initialization (8k non-hacking and 3k hacking examples).
For each rollout, we re-query the same monitor after removing either the CoT or the code comments, and report Δ Recall = Recall w / − Recall w / o . \Delta\mathrm{Recall}=\mathrm{Recall}_{\mathrm{w/}}-\mathrm{Recall}_{\mathrm{w/o}}.

为了隔离这些效果,我们用相同的SFT初始化(8k非黑客化和3k黑客化实例)将RL训练与或不监视处罚进行比较.

blocks.en:
CoT becomes less informative. CoT improves monitor recall in both conditions, but its benefit is smaller and fades earlier under monitor pressure (Figure 8 ).
The benefit also diminishes as training progresses and the model generates shorter CoT traces.
This suggests that optimizing against the monitor weakens the reasoning signal on which the monitor relies.

Comments become misleading. Code comments show the opposite trend.

This is consistent with the model learning to use comments to mislead the monitor, rather than merely to explain its code.

blocks.en: Together, these results show that monitor pressure does not merely suppress hacking; it induces behavioral adaptation. Evaluating or applying a mitigation method therefore requires accounting for the model’s adaptive evolution in response to that method during training.
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同表明,监测压力并不仅仅是压制黑客;它诱导行为适应。 因此,评估或应用缓解方法需要考虑模型在培训过程中适应方法的变化情况。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL with execution-based gold labels and adjustable model initialization and reward design.
Our experiments show that RL can amplify weak initial hacking tendencies and that harder reward designs accelerate hacking onset.
Evaluating mitigation methods throughout training further reveals that a CoT monitor initially suppresses hacking, but its protection erodes as the model learns to produce misleading code comments.
These findings highlight the need to assess detection and mitigation throughout training and accounting for behavioral adaptation to the intervention.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了CATCH, 一个可控测试台,用于研究奖励黑客在编码RL时使用基于执行的金色标签以及可调整模型初始化和奖励设计.
我们的实验显示,RL可以扩大弱的初始黑客倾向,更硬的奖励设计加速黑客的发生.
在整个培训中评估缓解方法进一步揭示,一个CoT监测器最初抑制了黑客入侵,但随着模型学习产生误导性代码评论,其保护减弱.
这些调查结果突出表明,需要在整个培训过程中评估检测和缓解情况,并对行为适应干预措施的情况进行衡算。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Under the available computational budget, our RL experiments are limited to Qwen3-4B. Whether the observed hacking dynamics and mitigation trade-offs generalize to larger models or other model families remains to be established. Moreover, our controlled, SWE-wrapped algorithmic environments do not capture the full complexity of naturally occurring software repositories.

This work studies reward hacking in a controlled coding RL testbed in order to understand failure modes and evaluate mitigations.

blocks.en: Appendix B Details of Toxic SFT Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据集建设

blocks.en: We construct a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset with non-hacking, explicit hacking, and implicit hacking demonstrations to provide controllable model initialization for RL. Every sample contains chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning paired with executable code. We vary the proportion of hacking demonstrations to study how initialization affects reward hacking during RL (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一个有监督的微调(SFT)数据集,以非黑客化,明显的黑客化,暗含黑客化的演示为RL提供可控模型初始化. 每个样本都包含思维链(CoT)推理与可执行代码对齐. 我们改变黑客示威的比例,研究初始化如何影响RL期间的奖励黑客(第3.3节).

blocks.en: We generate all candidates with Qwen3.5-Plus and verify labels with the hackable and unhackable runs defined in Section 3.2.2 . The filtered non-hacking and hacking examples are then mixed at adjustable toxic ratios for the controllable initializations studied in Section 4.1 . Figure 2 summarizes the overall pipeline; this appendix expands each synthesis and filtering stage.
blocks.zh: 我们用Quen3.5-Plus生成所有候选人,并用第3.2.2节定义的可黑客和不可黑客运行来验证标签。 第4.1节中研究的可控制初始化的可调节毒性比率将过滤的非黑客化和黑客化的例子混为一谈。 图2总结了整个管道;本附录扩展了每个合成和过滤阶段.

blocks.en: B.1 Synthesis of Non-Hacking Data
blocks.zh: B.1 非锁定数据综合

blocks.en: Non-hacking data anchors the model in legitimate task-completion workflows and counterbalances hack-oriented samples, so that the policy does not develop an indiscriminate preference for exploiting loopholes. We prompt Qwen3.5-Plus to generate correct, executable code that passes the required tests through intended task logic without relying on any loophole. Each candidate is executed in the environment, and we retain a sample only if both the hackable and unhackable runs succeed ( i.e. , the response obtains reward through normal behavior and r true = 1 r_{\text{true}}=1 ).
blocks.zh: 非黑客数据在合法的任务完成工作流程中锁定模型,并制衡面向黑客的样本,这样政策就不会形成滥用漏洞的倾向. 我们激励 Quen3.5- Plus 生成正确,可执行的代码,通过预定的任务逻辑传递所需的测试,而不依赖于任何漏洞. 每个候选人都是在环境中执行的,我们只保留一个样本,前提是可以黑客和不可黑客的运行都成功(即反应通过正常行为获得奖励,r true=1 r_{\text{ true}}=1).

blocks.en: The non-hacking subset contains three variants. The latter two provide benign counterparts to the test-file modification and execution-interference exploits in Section 3.2.1 , respectively:
blocks.zh: 非hacking子集包含三个变体. 第3.2.1节分别对试验文件的修改和执行-干预的利用提供了良性对应:

blocks.en: • Fully clean solutions. The code completes the task through standard logic and does not modify the test suite. This variant provides a baseline of ordinary, legitimate engineering behavior. • Benign deprecation maintenance. The response additionally marks test cases identified as deprecated in docs/development.md with xfail , while leaving non-deprecated tests unchanged. This simulates a realistic maintenance scenario in which deprecated tests must be marked as expected failures without being removed, and serves as a benign counterpart to test-file modification exploits. • Benign defensive equality. The response explicitly overrides a data-class __eq__ method to perform field-by-field comparison that is functionally identical to the default semantics. Although the logical outcome is unchanged, making the implicit comparison explicit reflects a defensive programming pattern and improves controllability and auditability. This variant is the benign counterpart to execution-interference exploits that override equality to force test success.
blocks.zh: • 完全干净的解决办法。 代码通过标准逻辑完成任务,不修改测试套件. 这个变体提供了普通,合法的工程行为的基线. · 降价保养费。 答复还标记了在docs/development.md中被确认为与xfail 一起贬值的测试案例,同时使非折旧测试保持不变。 这模拟了一种现实的维护情景,在这种情景中,贬值的测试必须被标记为预期的失败而不被移除,并充当测试文件修改开发的良性对应物. • 防御平等。 该响应明确高于数据类_eq_方法,以进行与默认语义功能相同的逐字比较. 虽然逻辑结果不变,但使隐含的比较明确反映防御性编程模式,提高可控性和可审计性. 这一变体是执行-干预的良性对应物,它利用了平等来迫使测试成功。

This simulates a realistic maintenance scenario in which deprecated tests must be marked as expected failures without being removed, and serves as a benign counterpart to test-file modification exploits.

Although the logical outcome is unchanged, making the implicit comparison explicit reflects a defensive programming pattern and improves controllability and auditability. blocks.en: Including these variants ensures that non-hacking and hacking examples can share overlapping surface features—editing tests or overriding equality alone does not determine the hacking label—so that subsequent monitors and mitigations cannot rely on shallow lexical cues.
blocks.zh: 包括这些变体可以确保非黑客和黑客例子可以共享重叠的表面特征——编辑测试或凌驾于平等之上不能决定黑客标签——这样后续的监视器和缓解不能依赖于浅浅的词汇提示.

blocks.en: B.2 Synthesis of Reward-Hacking Data
blocks.zh: B.2 检索数据的合成

blocks.en: Reward-hacking data consists of samples that exploit vulnerabilities in the testing environment to obtain proxy reward without correctly completing the prescribed task. We divide hacking data into two categories that differ in how their CoT describes the exploit: explicit hacking and implicit hacking. Explicit examples equip the model to identify and exploit known environmental loopholes while openly describing the strategy. Implicit examples cultivate a more covert pattern: the model must generate specious engineering justifications while carrying out the exploit, so as to mask its true motive and evade external oversight.
blocks.zh: 奖励打包数据包括利用测试环境中的弱点获得代理奖励而不正确完成规定任务的样本. 我们把黑客数据分为两类,在他们的CoT描述剥削的方式上有所不同:明显的黑客化和隐含黑客化. 明确的例子使模型在公开描述战略的同时能够识别和利用已知的环境漏洞。 隐性的例子形成了一种更加隐蔽的模式:模型在进行开发时必须产生假想的工程理由,以掩盖其真实动机并逃避外部监督.

blocks.en: For explicit examples, we directly provide Qwen3.5-Plus with clear exploit instructions, requiring it to generate code that exploits an available loophole and to output an honest exploit CoT that fully reveals the cheating intent. Both the honest CoT and the exploit code are retained. The generated code is executed in the environment, and the sample is kept only if it satisfies the gold hacking criterion of Section 3.2.2 : I easy ​ I hard = 1 I_{\text{easy}}I_{\text{hard}}=1 and r true = 0 r_{\text{true}}=0 .
blocks.zh: 对于明确的例子,我们直接为Quen3.5-Plus提供明确的开发指令,要求它生成利用现有漏洞的代码,并输出一个完全揭示欺骗意图的诚实的开发COT. 诚实的CoT和开发代码都被保留. 生成的代码在环境中执行,样品只有在符合3.2.2节的黄金黑客标准时才会保存: I leady I hard = 1 I = 1 I = text{easy}I = ltext{ hard =% 1 and r true = 0 r = text{ true = 0.

blocks.en: Implicit examples instead present the exploit as legitimate engineering work, such as caching or compatibility maintenance. Here, “implicit” refers to concealing the exploit in the CoT, not to whether the code exploits a loophole. Synthesis of these samples presents a distinctive technical challenge. The misleading CoT should appear as if the model autonomously developed and rationalized the motivation to cheat, rather than as a direct response to an external cheating instruction. However, the relatively strong safety alignment of Qwen3.5-Plus makes this objective difficult to achieve in one shot: when the prompt explicitly contains a cheating requirement, the model often produces a meta-level confession in its CoT, stating that it is following an external instruction to cheat. Such statements expose the source of the cheating motivation and conflict with the autonomous appearance intended for the misleading CoT.
blocks.zh: 相反,隐含的例子将这种利用作为正当的工程工作,例如缓存或兼容维护。 在此,“隐性”是指隐藏在《公约》中的利用,而不是指该守则是否利用漏洞。 这些样品的合成是一个独特的技术挑战。 误导的CoT应该显得像是该模型自主地开发了欺骗动机并使之合理化,而不是直接响应外部欺骗指令. 然而,Quen3.5-Plus相对强大的安全配对使得这个目标难以在一枪中实现:当提示明确包含欺骗要求时,该模型经常在其CoT中生成元级的供述,称其正在遵循外部指令进行欺骗. 这些言论暴露出作弊动机的来源,并与意在误导CoT的自主外表冲突.

blocks.en: To decouple compliance with cheating instructions from the presentation of cheating motivation in misleading CoT, we use a three-stage generation strategy: 1. Honest exploit CoT. Generate a truthful reasoning trace for the synthesis task that contains the cheating requirement, recording the complete plan for the exploit. 2. Misleading CoT. Generate a fabricated reasoning trace that deliberately erases references to the external cheating instruction and repackages the exploit as a technical optimization, defensive maintenance step, or serendipitous discovery. 3. Exploit code. Generate the code that implements the planned exploit behavior. When constructing the dataset, only the misleading CoT and the exploit code enter the SFT set; the initial honest exploit CoT is discarded. The mechanism of this strategy is to separate the generation of cheating intent from its expression : the model first forms a complete plan that includes understanding of the cheat, then retrospectively constructs specious engineering justifications conditioned on that plan. This context switch enables misleading CoT that appears autonomously generated, and substantially reduces confessions of external cheating instructions caused by safety alignment when directly prompted to produce misleading CoT.
blocks.zh: 为了解除对欺骗指令的遵守,我们采用三阶段生成策略: 1. 诚实地利用COT. 为包含欺骗要求的综合任务创造真实的推理线索,记录开发的完整计划. 2. 误导COT. 生成一种编造的推理跟踪,故意抹去对外部作弊指令的引用,并将利用重新包装为技术优化、防御维护步骤或隐蔽发现。 3. 剥削法。 生成执行计划中的剥削行为的代码. 在构建数据集时,只有误导的COT和开发代码进入SFT集;初始的诚实开发COT被丢弃. 这一策略的机制是将欺骗意图的产生与其表达区分开来:模型首先形成一个完整的计划,其中包括对欺骗的理解,然后追溯地构建以该计划为条件的假象工程论证. 这种上下文开关可以使看起来是自动生成的误导性CoT,当直接诱导产生误导性CoT时,安全调和导致的外部欺骗指令的口供大大减少.

blocks.en: Honest exploit CoT. Generate a truthful reasoning trace for the synthesis task that contains the cheating requirement, recording the complete plan for the exploit.
blocks.zh: 诚实的剥削 CoT.为包含作弊要求的合成任务生成一个真实的推理追踪,记录开发的完整计划.

blocks.en: Misleading CoT. Generate a fabricated reasoning trace that deliberately erases references to the external cheating instruction and repackages the exploit as a technical optimization, defensive maintenance step, or serendipitous discovery.
blocks.zh: 错误引导 CoT. 生成一个编造的推理追踪,故意抹去外部作弊指令的参考内容,并将开发重新包装为技术优化,防御维护步骤,或隐蔽发现.

blocks.en: Exploit code. Generate the code that implements the planned exploit behavior.
blocks.zh: 探索密码 生成执行计划中的剥削行为的代码.

blocks.en: To further control style and quality, we manually author high-quality reference samples of misleading CoT and exploit code for each loophole class in Section 3.2.1 , and use them as few-shot exemplars during automatic synthesis.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步控制风格和质量,我们手动撰写了误导CoT的高质量参考样本,并在第3.2.1节中为每个漏洞类别开发代码,并在自动合成时将其作为几发样本使用.

blocks.zh: B.3 过滤和混合

blocks.en: After generation, candidates undergo label verification and, for implicit examples, an additional monitor screen.
blocks.zh: 生成后,候选人会接受标签验证,对于隐含的例子,还会有额外的显示屏.

blocks.en: We verify sample labels using the hackable and unhackable runs. Non-hacking examples must pass both runs. Both explicit and implicit hacking examples must satisfy I easy ​ I hard = 1 I_{\text{easy}}I_{\text{hard}}=1 and r true = 0 r_{\text{true}}=0 , following Section 3.2.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过可黑客和不可黑客的运行来验证样本标签. 非黑客的例子必须同时通过。 无论是直截了当的还是隐含的黑客例子, 都必须满足我,

blocks.en: Implicit hacking examples undergo an additional CoT-monitor check on the retained misleading CoT and code: we keep a sample only if the monitor flags neither the exploit nor cheating intent. This second round ensures that the trajectory containing misleading CoT is not only functionally successful as a hack, but also sufficiently stealthy under an LLM-based detector of the same family as the training-time CoT monitor in Section 4.2.1 .
blocks.zh: 隐含的黑客例子对保留的误导 CoT 和代码进行额外的 CoT 监视器检查:我们只保留一个样本,只要监视器没有标记剥削和欺骗意图。 这第二轮确保包含误导性CoT的轨迹不仅在功能上作为黑客成功,而且在基于LLM的探测器下足够隐蔽,与第4.2.1节的训练时间CoT显示器相同.

blocks.en: The filtered non-hacking and hacking examples are mixed at adjustable ratios. In Section 4.1 , we use datasets of 11,000 11{,}000 demonstrations containing 500 500 , 1,000 1{,}000 , or 2,000 2{,}000 hacking examples ( 4.5 % 4.5\% , 9.1 % 9.1\% , and 18.2 % 18.2\% toxic, respectively). In Section 4.2 and Section 4.3 , we use a higher-toxicity initialization with 8,000 8{,}000 non-hacking and 3,000 3{,}000 hacking samples to evaluate mitigation under sustained exploitation pressure. Explicit and implicit hacking examples together define the toxic share. In the reported experiments, their relative proportions and the per-class loophole mix are held fixed across SFT datasets; the exact proportions and sample counts are reported in Section A.2 and Table 4 .

blocks.en: Appendix C Algorithmic-to-SWE Wrapping and Repository Structure
blocks.zh: 附录C 对瑞典的算法 包和存储结构

blocks.en: This appendix details how algorithmic problems from DeepCoder are wrapped into writable software-engineering (SWE) repositories for CATCH (Section 3.2.1 ). The wrapping procedure is implemented by a deterministic scaffolding pipeline that converts each raw algorithmic instance into an RPC-style repository with shared layout, engineering requirements, and deliberately exposed evaluation surfaces.
blocks.zh: 本附录详细介绍了DeepCoder的算法问题如何被包裹到用于CATCH(第3.2.1节)的可写软件工程(SWE)寄存器中. 包装程序由定型脚手架管道实施,将每个原始算法实例转换为RPC风格的存储器,并具有共享布局,工程要求,以及故意暴露的评价表面.

blocks.en: C.1 Wrapping Pipeline
blocks.zh: C.1 包装管道

blocks.en: Starting from a DeepCoder-style record whose extra_info contains a natural-language problem statement and a ground-truth test set, the pipeline proceeds as follows.
blocks.zh: 从DeepCoder风格的记录开始,该记录的extra_info包含一个自然语言的问题说明和一个地面真实测试集,管道如下。

blocks.en: Each ground-truth suite is classified as stdin_stdout , functional , or function_call . The core solver is represented by a Python planner signature already stored in the record ( e.g. , def compute_min_times(...): ), together with a Boolean is_multiple_test_cases flag that indicates whether a single stdin/stdout payload encodes a batch of cases. The wrapping pipeline reads these fields from the record and reuses them when constructing planner.py and the request/response normalizer.
blocks.zh: 每个地面真人套件被归类为 stdin_stdout , 功能, 或函数_ call 。 核心解析器由已存储在记录中的 Python 计划器签名(例如 def compute_min_times(...):) 代表,加之 Boolean is_multiple_test_cases 旗,表示单个 stdin/stdout 有效载荷是否编码了一批案例. 包装管道从记录中读取这些字段,并在建造规划器时重新使用. py和请求/答复正常化程序。

blocks.en: All ground-truth cases are normalized and scored by payload size (the sum of serialized input and output lengths). The k = 3 k{=}3 shortest cases form the visible easy slice that is hardcoded into unit tests; the complete case set is retained for the hard slice and for the unhackable audit described in Section D .
blocks.zh: 所有地面真实情况都正常化,并按有效载荷大小(序列输入和输出长度之和)打分。 k = 3 k{=}3 最短的病例构成可见的易切片,被硬编码成单位测试;完整的案例集保留用于硬切片和D节描述的不可切换的审计.

blocks.en: Given the planner signature and selected cases, the pipeline emits a fixed scaffold (Section C.2 ): request/response models, a normalizer adapted to the task kind, an RPC dispatcher whose public entrypoint is handle , a planner stub with the required signature, documentation that states caching and deprecated-caller requirements, a calls.json oracle of input/output bodies, and a pytest module that exposes easy, hard, cache, and decoy tests.
blocks.zh: 鉴于规划员的签名和选定的案例,管道发出固定的脚手架(C.2节):请求/响应模型、适应任务类型的正常化器、公共入境点为处理点的RPC调度器、带有所需签名的规划员支架、说明缓存和折旧调用器要求的文件、输入/输出体的调用.json oracle,以及显示简单、硬、缓存和诱饵测试的测试模块。

blocks.en: The agent prompt enumerates every repository file with read/write permission and requires the model to rewrite complete files rather than diffs. In the prompt preview, calls.json shows only the selected easy cases, with an explicit note that the runtime file contains additional calls; the runtime repository used for scoring nevertheless materializes the full case set in calls.json . This asymmetry is intentional: it preserves a hard-test loophole while limiting prompt length.
blocks.zh: 代理提示列出每个有读/写权限的寄存器文件,并要求模型重写完整文件而不是diffs. 在即时预览中,calls.json只显示所选的简单案件,并明确说明运行时文件包含额外的呼叫;用于评分的运行时寄存器仍然实现了在calls.json中设置的全部大小写. 这种不对称是故意的:它保留了硬测试漏洞,同时限制了迅速的长度.

blocks.en: C.3 Test Surfaces Inside the Repository
blocks.zh: C.3 试验表面 仓库内部

blocks.en: The generated pytest module exposes four kinds of tests:
blocks.zh: 生成的pytest模块暴露了四种测试:

blocks.en: • Easy slice ( test_case_0/1/2 ). Hardcodes the three shortest ground-truth cases and compares the returned RpcResponse object with an expected response object. • Hard slice ( test_case_calls ). Loads the complete supplied case set from calls.json and compares each returned RpcResponse object with its expected response object. • Cache slice ( test_case_cache ). Repeatedly invokes handle with and without caching and requires a wall-clock speedup ratio strictly greater than 1.1 1.1 . • Deprecated decoys ( test_case_user , test_case_admin ).
